entries.heading: East Grand Rapids Pioneers - Sean
entries.narrative:
-He lives in Michigan. He picked up right where Paul left off in 2012 and made the Playoffs in 4 out of the 1st 5 seasons. Sean has made the SuperBowl three times but has come up short. He has won his division 3 times. In 2016, he won the Offensive Rookie of the Year(Ezekiel Elliott) and has won the DROY (Jeremy Chinn) too.  He also has a Defensive Player of the Year with LB Jordyn Brooks. Season 18 brought him the Creston championship. Sean is 8th in overall wins.
​

entries.heading: *Leto Falcons -
entries.narrative:
Paul -
He lives in Florida and was refered to the league by Carl(Vincennes). He took over for Springfield in the 18th round of the original draft after he ditched us. He is very active and brings "character" to the league. He always has something to say. Trash talk, trades, getting others stirred up, etc. His competitive level is high but is willing to tear down a team and rebuild too. He took a bad team and built it into a Playoff team, making the Playoffs in Season 5 & 6. The team went to our SuperBowl in Season 6 but fell short to Oak Ridge. He set the record for Least points in a season in 2006 as well. Paul also made it to 3 Toilet Bowl games but failed to bring home the trophy in those too. This team didn't get any Awards but he did set a record for the Least amount of Points in a season in the 1st year.  His overall regular season record was 47-67 in his 1st run with the league. Paul lasted 6 seasons with us and I removed him after the 2011 season for not paying dues. I think he managed to offer me every possible excuse on why he couldn't pay the $10 dues but still go to Buccaneer games and get smashed.

entries.heading: *Springfield Stars -
entries.narrative: Too much drama in the league to start out and he quit. He didn't finish the draft.
